provenance: Original AI-assisted project artwork requested by the user; no extracted game assets, photographs, existing paintings or book covers.
ownership: Project-generated artwork; exclusive copyright ownership is not certified.

sources.layout: 2 columns by 2 rows; two fixed-anchor poses per vendor

conversion: Painting cells are selected independently, then contained without cropping inside centered frames. Directional sprites use reviewed source row bounds, consistent native scale, bottom-center anchors and mirrored opposite-side views; they are not duplicated front views. See scripts/prepare_venue_art.py. Exact hashes of every source and prepared sprite are recorded in normalization.json.

high_definition_revision.authorization: The user asked for higher-definition wall textures and skies generated with a high-end image AI so the game reads as more convincingly 3D.

reviewed_layouts.skies_squares.png: 1536x1024; three stacked panorama strips with divider rows at 345-348 and 690-694: dusk entertainment square (TSKYSAN), overcast civic city hall (TSKYNAT), downtown CN Tower and domed stadium (TSKYROG)
reviewed_layouts.skies_waterfront.png: 1536x1024; divider rows at 337-341 and 679-682: blue-hour arena district (TSKYSCO), park treeline with legislature (TSKYQPK), lake sunset skyline (TSKYISL)
reviewed_layouts.materials_city.png: 4x2 atlas: asphalt, cobblestone, precast concrete base, limestone hotel facade, ribbed stage steel, stucco kiosk, platform-edge concrete, bolted steel panel
reviewed_layouts.materials_arena.png: 4x2 atlas: ribbed stadium concrete, navy stadium seats, rink dasher boards, ice, arena roof deck, track ballast, black stage planks, ribbed steel door

high_definition_revision.conversion: Skies use reviewed 1536x192 windows anchored at each strip's skyline base, graded away from palette-hostile blue, resized to the native 1024x128 sky sampling grid and wrap-blended. Wall cells are cropped inside the divider lines, downsampled to native texel density with baked lighting and ambient occlusion, and edge-blended for seamless tiling. See scripts/venue_art.py site_material and scripts/expansion_presentation.py venue_skies.

directional_revision.authorization: The user explicitly approved generating new directional sprite-sheet images and varied fan groups using existing artwork as references.

reviewed_layouts.people-directions-source.png: 8 columns / 8 rows; first five views plus mirrored opposite sides
reviewed_layouts.crowd-directions-source.png: 7 columns / 11 occupied rows; eight reviewed group designs, first five views plus mirrored opposite sides
reviewed_layouts.animals-directions-source.png: 5 columns / 7 rows; reviewed nonuniform row bounds
reviewed_layouts.wildlife-directions-source.png: 5 columns / 7 rows; reviewed nonuniform row bounds

directional_revision.native_orientation: Reviewed columns run from front through left profile to rear. Only opposite-side rotations 6-8 are mirrored; native KEX side captures caught and corrected reversed people/crowd profiles.
directional_revision.animation: Where paired poses exist, use both; otherwise apply a subtle upper-body breathing/bobbing pose while keeping feet planted. Referee wears a black-and-white vertically striped shirt and black pants in every direction.
